entries.title: Psalms 63:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David's thirst for God. 4 His manner of blessing God. 9 His confidence of his enemies' destruction, and his own safety.

A.M. 2943. B.C. 1061. (Title.) when. 1Sa 22:5; 23:14-16,23-25; 26:1-3; 2Sa 15:28 thou. 31:14; 42:11; 91:2; 118:28; 143:10; Ex 15:2; Jer 31:1,33; Zec 13:9 Joh 20:17 early. 5:3; 78:34; Job 8:5; Pr 1:27,28; 8:17; So 3:1-3; Ho 5:15; Mt 6:33 soul. 42:1,2; 84:2; 119:81; 143:6; Joh 7:37; Re 7:16,17 flesh. 102:3-5; So 5:8 dry and thirsty land, where no water is. Heb. weary landwithout water. Ex 17:3; Isa 32:2; 35:7; 41:18; Mt 12:43

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
My soul, etc."My soul cleaveth {davekah} after Thee;" which not only shews the diligence of the pursuit, and the nearness of the attainment, but the fast hold he had of the mercy of God.

followeth. 73:25; 143:6,7; Ge 32:26-28; 2Ch 31:21; So 3:2; Isa 26:9; Mt 11:12 Lu 13:24; 18:5-7 thy. 18:35; 37:24; 73:23; 94:18; So 2:6; Isa 41:10; 42:1; Php 2:12,13 Col 1:29

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: They shall fall, etc. Heb. They shall make him run out, likewater, by the hands of the sword. 1Sa 26:10; 31:1-6; Jer 18:21; Eze 35:5 a portion. So 2:15; Eze 39:4,17-20; Re 19:17,18

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
But, etc.David shall come to the kingdom according to the promise of God.

the king. 2:6; 21:1; 1Sa 23:17; 24:20 sweareth. De 6:13; Isa 19:18; 45:23; 65:16; Zep 1:5; Heb 6:13 the mouth. 31:18; Ro 3:19; Tit 1:10,11
